question: The maximum limit on microfinance loans for NBFCs other than NBFC-MFIs is _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is **25% of the total assets**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The maximum limit on microfinance loans for NBFCs other than NBFC-MFIs is 25% of the total assets.
 
• This regulation ensures that NBFCs diversify their loan portfolios and do not overly expose themselves to microfinance loans.
 
• NBFCs (Non-Banking Financial Companies) are financial institutions that offer various banking services but do not have a banking license.
 
• **Microfinance loans are small loans provided to individuals or small businesses who do not have access to traditional banking services.
 
• NBFC-MFIs are a specific category of NBFCs that primarily deal with microfinance activities and have different regulatory requirements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Microfinance** is a type of financial service aimed at providing small loans, savings, and other financial services to **low-income individuals** or those who do not have access to traditional banking services. It plays a crucial role in **financial inclusion** and economic development by empowering individuals to start or expand small businesses, improve their living standards, and achieve financial stability.

 
 

 Term
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Microfinance
 Financial services provided to low-income individuals or groups who are typically excluded from traditional banking services.
 
 

 NBFC
 Non-Banking Financial Companies that offer various financial services but do not hold a banking license.
 
 

 NBFC-MFI
 A specific category of NBFCs that primarily deal with microfinance activities.
 
 

 Financial Inclusion
 The effort to make financial services accessible to all individuals, especially those who are underserved by traditional financial institutions.
 
 

 Loan Portfolio Diversification
 The practice of spreading loan investments across various sectors to reduce risk.
